R1.description: From round 2 a review gets the changes since the last reviewed bundle and that round's findings, at both stages and both review stages; approvals still bind the full content

R2.description: A REVISE with no Blocking or Important finding, an APPROVE that lists a Blocking finding, or an APPROVE that declares a changes-only review, is refused as malformed and reissued, never converted

R3.description: An additive protocol 1.4 field gives the current review round per stage, from existing state; accepting at a cap stays a person's step

R4.description: /milestone-plan asks for small plans and warns, without blocking, above a checkpoint-count threshold

R5.description: Small fixes: the RELEASING.md fixture path, the /review-plan refusal's next step, a line wrap in milestone-plan.md

R6.description: The Orchestration Protocol states when a distinct-provider verdict courier at an external_gate is admissible, with five conditions, as documentation only (workflow#28)
